charger.selection: the first row Host B draws (nearest its origin), which "take me to the first one" selects

walking.method: great-circle metres x grid factor / metres per minute, rounded up; computed by the script, never by the model

scoring.scale: each criterion 0-5; total = 100 x sum(weight x score / 5)
scoring.gate: open Thursday 5-6 pm with a cited source, else disqualified
scoring.openScore: from the cited Thursday closing time: 7 pm or later 5, 6:30 pm 4, 6 pm 3; without one the model's score, at most 3
scoring.uncited: a criterion without a valid citation scores 0
scoring.tieBreak: total, then shorter walk, then nearer, then OSM id
